\begin{document}
The band starts at $\epsilon_0>0$; the energy $\epsilon$ of a state is measured from the Fermi level and
takes either sign. In imaginary time the propagator of a state of energy $\epsilon$ integrates to
\begin{equation}
\int_0^{\infty} d\tau\, e^{-\epsilon\tau} = \frac{1}{\epsilon} .
\label{eq:lap}
\end{equation}
